entities.name: small house with a gateway at the top of the silk
entities.what: A low single-storey house at the very top of the silk, east of the open shop with tables (structures_w's): a dark tiled roof band, a small lattice window under its eave (u 14205-14240), and at its east end a narrow gateway frame with a lintel and a lattice transom (u 14290-14340). Mostly hidden behind the bare whips of the big willow. No writing.
entities.vis: part: front and feet behind the willow's whips; back beyond the silk's top edge (v ~15)
entities.note: Roof band v 18-50 from u ~14105 (where the open shop's east post stands at 14100-14105, v 50-118) to ~14285; eave v 45-50. Lattice window 14205-14240 (v 40-60). Gateway: posts 14290-14295 and 14335-14340 (v 28-75/95), lintel v 28, lattice transom 14295-14335 (v 30-45). Base est: front at v ~85-88 (the vertical strokes of the window and gate run to v 75-95; the restyle puts the front at v 75-80); back corners at the silk's top edge (placeholder). Its west end may be the same roof as the open shop at 13895-14105 (structures_w, main point < 14000): the eave steps at 14105, so it is recorded separately. SCALE CUES: gateway 45-50 px wide (14292-14338), lintel 28 to foot ~85 (≈57 px) at foot v ~85.

entities.name: tiled house at the top of the bank, set askew
entities.what: A single-storey tiled house at the top of the bank, west of the moorings, its roof seen from above and set askew to the road: the east side runs up to the right toward the river under an eave with a row of round tile ends over a plain wall; at its south-west end open bays on three posts with a low railing between the first two, facing the bank path where a porter and two figures walk (t4's).
entities.vis: part: the west end behind the willow's whips
entities.note: Roof outline (scan, zoom 3 and contrast-enhanced): west corner (14504,178), north (14615,114), east (14754,184), south (14612,278); the eave with round tile ends runs (14615,274)->(14742,197), slope -0.62 (up-right); the edge (14504,178)->(14612,278) slopes +0.93 (a hip or the south-west verge). Posts: 14517-14522 (v 253-297), 14593-14600 (v 273-310), 14642-14647 (v 253-307), a short post 14735 (v 235-255); railing 14530-14600 (v 280-300); a wall end at u ~14760 (v 187-237). Base: sw and se are the post feet, ne/nw est (the east side's direction, slope -0.63, carried ~120 px). TWO READINGS: (1) a house whose long side recedes up-right (as the south row does), its open end facing the path (facing 225 here); (2) the restyle's: a long house whose front wall faces south-east toward the river (from (14555,300) to (14770,180)). It is NOT drawn with the tea house's up-left recession. SCALE CUES: posts 37-54 px tall at foot v ~300-310 (the painter's scale here is about 0.3-0.4 of the road's).

entities.name: house behind the riverbank house (far roof with a light gable)
entities.what: Behind (north of) the riverbank house, a second tiled roof running east toward the house with tables, with a light triangular gable end at its west end (a post standing in it).
entities.vis: part: only the roof and the gable above the riverbank house's roof show; its walls and feet are hidden

Its east end meets the house with tables (S4b.bld.top_house_tables_*), whose own west gable is at 14700-14750 (v 112-162): two buildings, or one long one with two gables (unclear). Base corners are placeholders behind the riverbank house's roof.

entities.name: house with an open shop front and tables, by the moorings
entities.what: A single-storey tiled house at the top of the silk, beside the moorings: its west part is an open shop front with two or three tables and benches under the eave (a tea or food stall; the furniture is the tile agents'), with a boarded lattice at its west end; its east part is a plain plastered wall under an eave with a row of round tile ends, ending at a post at u 15030. The roof rises to the silk's top edge. No writing.
entities.vis: part: back beyond the silk's top edge; the west end behind the riverbank house's roof
entities.note: Eave v 115-125 at the west, a row of round tile ends 14870-15030 (v 100-120); posts 14777 (v 127-187), 14877-14880 (v 120-173), east end post 15030 (v 100-143+); white wall 14880-15000, base (14880,167)->(15000,157); west gable end and a boarded lattice 14700-14790 (v 112-170). Tables at 14763-14870 (v 127-205): one top reads (14780,142),(14802,151),(14857,136),(14837,127). Base: front corners est (sw at the west posts' feet v ~190-200, se at the east post), back corners at the silk's edge (placeholder). The front is not one straight line: the open shop part stands ~40 px further south than the wall. SCALE CUES: post 14777 is 60 px tall at foot v ~190; wall ~45 px (v 120-165).

entities.name: faint long shed at the top edge, north-east of the house with tables
entities.what: Faint: a long low shed at the top edge of the silk, north-east of the house with tables and just west of the top boat: a darker roof band, three posts and a base line.
entities.note: Read on a contrast-enhanced crop: roof band v 17-45 from u ~14950 to 15167; a lighter wall band v 50-80 (u 15017-15167); posts 15040-15053, 15102-15107, 15160-15163 (v 37-73); base line v ~80 (u 15017-15183). Vertical strokes at u 15217-15240 (v 17-60) east of it are tree trunks (left to t5).

entities.name: open mat-roofed shed at the top of the bank, behind the tea house
entities.what: A small open shed at the top of the bank behind the tea house's roofs: a roof of woven mat or thatch (cross-hatched strokes; the restyle paints tiles) on posts, its east verge sloping down toward the river, with a post-and-brace frame under its east end; two men stand at its east end (t4's figures). Its west part runs behind the willow's whips and the tea house roof. No walls show.
entities.vis: part: west part behind willow whips and tree branches; feet behind the tea house's east roof
entities.note: East verge (14450,492)->(14560,600), slope +0.98 (it recedes up-left, as the tea house does); eave v ~600 from ~14470 to 14560; posts and braces 14480-14527 (v 597-647); the figure at 14530-14560 stands with feet ~690 (est, behind the tea house's east roof, whose top edge passes here at v ~650-700). A structure, not a building: a roof on posts with no walls. Base corners est: the east posts' feet ~690, the shed carried up-left along its verge direction ~100 px (placeholder). Support: bank top (the bank's foot is hidden behind the tea house; H from the river agent). MERGE: t4 reads the same roof on posts as a small roofed gate (roof u 14450-14600, v 490-640; posts at u 14465 and 14525-14529, a diagonal brace at u 14500-14520, v 625-660) through which the path leads north onto the riverside ground; its two figures (S4b.fig.man_at_gate_post_14540, S4b.fig.figure_behind_roof_14583) stand at its east posts. One structure either way.

entities.name: the tea house: open hall with a mat canopy over its front (小铺闲坐?)
entities.what: The tea house: a large single-storey open hall on a low platform, north of the road. A big tiled gable roof whose south gable (king post, tie beam, short posts) faces the road, and a second, smaller tiled gable roof running parallel on its east side; across the whole front a broad lean-to canopy of mat or thatch (cross-hatched strokes) with a fringed eave, carried on posts. No front wall: under the canopy and the big roof's west eave stand long tables and benches where customers sit (t4's figures and furniture). A lattice screen closes the west end. No signboard, banner or writing is painted on it. At its north-west corner a pale doorway with a lattice transom and a small cap opens in the west (back) wall beside the big elm's trunk; along the east bays' front a low rail with capped end posts runs on the platform's edge.
entities.vis: part: the big roof's north part behind the big tree and the willow; the canopy hides the back wall; the east end behind the round parasol
entities.note: ROOF: the big roof's west eave (14127,871)->(14396,971); its top edge v ~601 from 14137 to 14433 (trees hide the rest); the south wing's ridge from (14424,601) down to the gable apex (14604,813); gable tie beam v ~894 from 14465 to 14742, king post 14596-14602 (v 813-894), short gable posts 14465-14477 (v 895-933); east eave (14742,894)->(14927,986). The second tiled roof east of the ridge spans u 14554-14859, v 653-840, its south gable end at about (14830-14850, 813-840) behind the parasol (one hall with two parallel roofs, or a separate east wing: unclear). CANOPY: back edge v ~930-937, eave v 1000-1014 from 14388 to 14935, fringe to v ~1020. POSTS: 14387-14394 (v 948-1183), 14438-14444 (v 987-1187), 14683-14691 (v 1014-1183), 14864-14875 (v 1014-1180), 14921-14937 (v 1014-1206); interior post 14523-14531 (v 1006-1060); no post shows between 14444 and 14683 (the seated customers hide that stretch). Lattice screen 14350-14390 (v 948-1045) at the west end. BASE: sw and se are the end posts' feet; nw/ne est: the hall recedes up-LEFT (platform edge and furniture slope +0.4 to +0.9, median +0.75), its back wall is hidden behind the canopy at about v 1000 (the deepest benches stand at v 1030-1060), so the back corners are the front corners moved 183-206 px up and 244-275 px left. At the NW corner a pale doorway (MERGE, below). The tables at u 14150-14330 stand on the platform under the big roof's west eave, outside the west posts. SCALE CUES: post 14441 is 200 px from canopy eave to foot (v 987->1187); post spacing 50 px (14391-14441) and 60 px (14870-14930); table H3 top v 1120-1135, foot 1181 (≈50 px); bench H2 top v 1105-1144, feet 1156-1183 (40-50 px); table B2 top 1050, feet 1107 (≈55 px); gable 277 px wide at the tie beam, 81 px high. DEPTH DIRECTION: up-left, dx ≈ -68 px/m (median of the ground-level edges in the report), the opposite of the road west of here (+31.6) and of the south row's ridges (up-right). MERGE: (1) the doorway: structures_e had it as a prop, S4b.prop.white_box_14147 (retired): a pale panel u 14130-14168, v 905-1000 under a small lattice (v 885-905) and a dark cap (v 875-885), its east edge running on down as a post to v ~1030, 125 x 38 px; t4 read it as a doorway with a lattice transom between two posts (kept; the restyle paints a doorway too). (2) The front rail (t4 left it to structures_e, which did not name it; t5 called it a bench): a low rail at v 1195-1205 over u 14720-14862 with capped end posts at ~14722 and ~14857 running down to v ~1225, on the platform's front edge (crop c_rail.jpg); t5's reading, a long bench there, is the other. (3) t3's pale mottled shape between the big elm's stems (u 14045-14085, v 827-900) is not a figure (no head or outline, t3 and the merge agent): a light wall of this hall's west end or a cloth beyond the trunk; t3's "vertical board at (14180-14220, 860-940)" is this doorway's east post and the hall's west eave line, nothing separate. (4) t4 also saw a back opening at u 14497-14537, v 1013-1053 and a pale hanging curtain under the west lattice screen (u 14341-14392, v 1037-1150): part of this hall.

entities.name: the tea house's low platform (terrace)

West edge (14143,1050)->(14300,1150), slope +0.64 (two lines ~10-15 px apart where it is clearest: the platform's side face, so H ≈ 0.15-0.2 m); corner (14317,1163); front v 1163-1165 to 14397, a step down to (14420,1185), front v ~1195-1208 under the hall's posts to the east post 14930 (est east end).
